title: Open Mic Night @ Railroad House
event_description: A weekly Monday night open mic hosted by Ernie Ernst at a friendly neighborhood sports bar in Sinking Spring. All styles of solo and acoustic performers are welcome to sign up and play.
event_venue_information:
Railroad House

Railroad House, also known as Jimmy G's Railroad House Sports Bar, is a friendly neighborhood sports bar in Sinking Spring with 26 HDTVs, a full food and drink menu, and a loyal local following.

Atmosphere and Setting

The bar has the easygoing, come-as-you-are feel of a classic sports bar, with games on every screen and a regular crowd that treats the open mic as a weekly ritual.

Open Mic Night

Every Monday from 8:00 to 11:00 PM, Railroad House hosts an open mic led by Ernie Ernst, welcoming singers, guitarists, and acoustic acts of all styles to sign up and play.

Other Programming

Beyond the Monday open mic, Railroad House's calendar centers on sports viewing and typical neighborhood bar programming.

Good to Know

Railroad House is located at 152 Woodrow Avenue in Sinking Spring, just outside Reading.

title: Open Mic Night @ Back Porch Brewing
event_description: A weekly Tuesday open mic at a downtown Carlisle brewery and restaurant, welcoming local musicians to play in a relaxed taproom setting over cold beer.
event_venue_information:
Back Porch Brewing

Back Porch Brewing is a craft brewery and restaurant in downtown Carlisle known for its house-brewed beer and a community-oriented calendar of weekly events.

Atmosphere and Setting

The taproom has a relaxed, neighborly feel, with local talent and cold beer as the draw on open mic nights.

Open Mic Night

Every Tuesday from 6:00 to 9:00 PM, Back Porch Brewing hosts an open mic welcoming local musicians to sign up and perform.

Other Programming

Back Porch Brewing also runs Music Bingo on the second and fourth Wednesday of the month with host Colby Dove, and Trivia Night every Thursday with Cheaters Never Prosper, alongside occasional live band performances and beer-release events.

Good to Know

Back Porch Brewing is located at 133 North Hanover Street in downtown Carlisle.

title: Open Mic @ Jen-Jen's Rhythm N Brews
event_description: A weekly Tuesday open mic with rotating hosts at a laid-back East Berlin brewery known for tacos and live acoustic music throughout the week.
event_venue_information:
Jen-Jen's Rhythm N Brews

Jen-Jen's Rhythm N Brews is a brewery and bar in East Berlin serving food, including tacos, alongside a regular calendar of live acoustic music.

Atmosphere and Setting

The brewery has a casual, community-driven vibe, with rotating hosts keeping the weekly open mic fresh for regulars and newcomers alike.

Open Mic

Every Tuesday from 6:00 to 9:00 PM, Jen-Jen's hosts an open mic with rotating hosts, most often Marshall Stone, and also Tommy B and Just Like Murray. Sign-up is in person and the night is free with no cover, 21 and up with valid ID.

Other Programming

Beyond the Tuesday open mic, Jen-Jen's regularly books live acoustic acts on other nights throughout the week.

Good to Know

Jen-Jen's Rhythm N Brews is located at 6726 Carlisle Pike in East Berlin.

title: Open Mic and Open Art @ Susquehanna River Creative Conspiracy
event_description: A weekly Tuesday open mic and open art night at a nonprofit community arts studio in Columbia, welcoming musicians and visual artists alike. A five dollar donation is suggested.
event_venue_information:
Susquehanna River Creative Conspiracy

Susquehanna River Creative Conspiracy, known locally as SRCC, is a nonprofit community arts studio and gallery space in Columbia that combines visual art with a weekly music and performance night.

Atmosphere and Setting

The studio has a DIY, all-ages, community-arts-center feel rather than a bar atmosphere, with several time slots reserved for in-person sign-up.

Open Mic and Open Art

Every Tuesday, doors open at 6:30 PM with the show starting at 7:00 PM for an Open Mic and Open Art night. A five dollar suggested donation applies, and a five dollar donation is required for anyone bringing their own drinks.

Other Programming

SRCC also books live shows and bands at the space, and periodically hosts off-site "SRCC Live in the Lounge" events at partner venues.

Good to Know

Susquehanna River Creative Conspiracy is located at 156B Lancaster Avenue in Columbia.

title: Acoustic Open Mic @ 551 West
event_description: A weekly Tuesday acoustic open mic in the First Floor Music Room of a downtown Lancaster bar and restaurant. Performers plug into the house PA; no drum kits or electric amps.
backline: House PA provided; no drum kits or electric amps
event_venue_information:
551 West

551 West is a bar and restaurant in downtown Lancaster with a dedicated First Floor Music Room and a full food and drink menu.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Music Room gives 551 West a live-music-forward identity beyond its regular bar service, with a busy weekly calendar of programmed nights.

Acoustic Open Mic

Every Tuesday from 7:00 to 9:00 PM, 551 West hosts an acoustic open mic in the Music Room. Performers plug directly into the house PA system; drum kits and electric amps are not permitted.

Other Programming

551 West also runs karaoke in the Music Room every Monday starting at 9:00 PM, alongside weekly food specials.

Good to Know

551 West is located at 551 West King Street in downtown Lancaster.

title: Open Mic Night @ Copper Pub and Grille
event_description: A Tuesday night open mic at a lively Harrisburg sports bar and grille, open to singers and musicians of all styles alongside the bar's regular entertainment lineup.
event_venue_information:
Copper Pub and Grille

Copper Pub and Grille is a sports bar, restaurant, and karaoke bar on North Mountain Road in Harrisburg with a lively, entertainment-driven calendar.

Atmosphere and Setting

The bar has a busy, sociable sports-bar-and-grille feel, with televised games, a full menu, and regular entertainment nights drawing a mixed local crowd.

Open Mic Night

Copper Pub and Grille hosts an open mic night on Tuesdays from 7:00 to 10:00 PM, welcoming singers and musicians to sign up and perform.

Other Programming

The pub's calendar also includes karaoke nights and past booked live acts, so it's worth checking their current schedule for the full lineup.

Good to Know

Copper Pub and Grille is located at 580 North Mountain Road in Harrisburg.

title: Ploughman's Open Mic @ Ploughman Cider
event_description: A welcoming weekly open mic on the Gettysburg town square, hosted by Rob at a cidery taproom known for its supportive, all-skill-levels crowd.
event_venue_information:
Ploughman Cider

Ploughman Cider is a cidery taproom right on the Gettysburg town square, pouring its own hard cider alongside a warm, community-driven calendar of live music.

Atmosphere and Setting

The taproom is known for a genuinely inclusive, supportive atmosphere, welcoming performers of every skill level from first-timers to seasoned regulars.

Ploughman's Open Mic

Every Wednesday, Ploughman Cider hosts its long-running open mic, with host Rob running sound and the sign-up list. Regulars like harmonica player "Cuz" and owner Ben are known to sit in.

Other Programming

Beyond the Wednesday open mic, Ploughman Cider runs a "Gentle Thursday" live music series featuring touring and local singer-songwriters.

Good to Know

Ploughman Cider is located at 14 Lincoln Square in downtown Gettysburg.

title: Open Mic and Jam Session @ McCleary's
event_description: A weekly Wednesday open mic and jam session at a historic riverside pub in Marietta, part of a full week of live music at the popular gastropub.
event_venue_information:
McCleary's

McCleary's is a pub and restaurant housed in a historic building in Marietta, a small Susquehanna riverside town known for its antiques district.

Atmosphere and Setting

The pub has a casual gastropub atmosphere with a full food and drink menu, popular with both locals and visitors browsing Marietta's shops.

Open Mic and Jam Session

McCleary's hosts an open mic and jam session on Wednesday nights, open to solo performers and full bands alike.

Other Programming

Beyond the Wednesday open mic, McCleary's books regular live music Thursday through Saturday nights.

Good to Know

McCleary's is located at 130 West Front Street in Marietta.

title: Open Mic @ Blue Sky Tavern
event_description: A weekly Wednesday open mic at a neighborhood tavern in Etters, between York and Harrisburg, with a relaxed bar-and-grill crowd.
event_venue_information:
Blue Sky Tavern

Blue Sky Tavern is a neighborhood tavern and restaurant in Etters, between York and Harrisburg, known for food and drink specials and a relaxed bar-and-grill feel.

Atmosphere and Setting

The tavern draws a mixed local crowd for its casual dining and regular entertainment calendar.

Open Mic

Blue Sky Tavern hosts an open mic every Wednesday, welcoming local performers to sign up and play.

Other Programming

The tavern's "Great Gigs in the Sky" events calendar suggests a broader lineup of booked live music beyond the weekly open mic.

Good to Know

Blue Sky Tavern is located at 895 Old Trail Road in Etters.

title: Open Mic Jam Session @ The Circle
event_description: A weekly Wednesday open mic and jam session led by the house Walnut Street Band at a bar on Hanover's town square, open to solo performers or players who want to sit in with the band.
event_venue_information:
The Circle

The Circle is a bar and restaurant on Hanover's town square with a full live-music calendar of local and regional bands.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Circle has a casual pub atmosphere anchored by its town-square location, drawing a steady crowd for its weekly entertainment lineup.

Open Mic Jam Session

Every Wednesday from 8:00 to 11:00 PM, The Circle hosts an open mic jam session led by the house Walnut Street Band, where players can join the band or perform solo.

Other Programming

The Circle's calendar also includes Trivia Night, Football Sunday, Friday Night DJ sets, and Music Bingo, alongside a regular lineup of booked bands.

Good to Know

The Circle is located at 5 East Walnut Street in downtown Hanover.

title: Open Mic Night @ Drunken Smithy Mead Hall
event_description: A free weekly open mic for music, poetry, and storytelling at a medieval-themed mead hall in Lebanon. A microphone, music stand, and speakers are provided.
backline: Microphone, music stand, and speakers provided
event_venue_information:
Drunken Smithy Mead Hall

Drunken Smithy Mead Hall is a medieval and Renaissance-themed tasting room inside Lebanon Valley Mall, part of the Drunken Smithy brand also known for blacksmithing and axe-throwing. It pours handcrafted meads, ciders, and wines alongside food and board games.

Atmosphere and Setting

The mead hall has a welcoming, community-gathering-space feel, themed around its medieval branding but casual and open to all.

Open Mic Night

Every Wednesday from 6:00 to 8:00 PM, Drunken Smithy Mead Hall hosts a free open mic for music, poetry, and storytelling. A microphone, music stand, and speakers are provided, and sign-up happens at the door.

Other Programming

The mead hall also runs live music Friday and Saturday evenings, karaoke Thursday and Saturday, and a monthly "Shanties & Shamrocks" Irish and sea-shanty night on the second Tuesday with Seamus Kelly.

Good to Know

Drunken Smithy Mead Hall is located inside Lebanon Valley Mall at 2236 Lebanon Valley Mall in Lebanon.

title: Open Mic (Midweek Jams) @ Wolf Brewing
event_description: A monthly open mic hosted by Dave Gates within Wolf Brewing's weekly Midweek Jams live music slot at a family-friendly Mechanicsburg brewpub.
venue_address: 100 Legacy Park Drive, Suite 400, Mechanicsburg, PA 17055
event_venue_information:
Wolf Brewing

Wolf Brewing is a brewery and scratch-kitchen restaurant in Legacy Park, Mechanicsburg, with a polished, family-friendly brewpub atmosphere and an outdoor beer garden.

Atmosphere and Setting

Wolf Brewing serves house-brewed beer and a full food menu in a space that comfortably mixes families, regulars, and live music fans.

Open Mic (Midweek Jams)

On select Wednesdays from 5:30 to 8:30 PM, as part of the brewery's weekly Midweek Jams live music slot, Wolf Brewing hosts a monthly open mic led by Dave Gates.

Other Programming

Beyond the monthly open mic, Wolf Brewing runs Friday Night Live music and acoustic music during Sunday brunch, plus special live music for holidays and anniversaries.

Good to Know

Wolf Brewing is located at 100 Legacy Park Drive, Suite 400, in Mechanicsburg.

title: Open Mic Night @ Bosler Public Library
event_description: A free, all-ages open mic night for music, poetry, and more at a public library in downtown Carlisle, held periodically throughout the year.
event_venue_information:
Bosler Public Library

Bosler Memorial Library is a public library in downtown Carlisle that runs a robust slate of free cultural programming for the community, including music events.

Atmosphere and Setting

As a public library, Bosler offers a welcoming, all-ages daytime-to-early-evening setting rather than a bar or club atmosphere.

Open Mic Night

Bosler periodically hosts a free Open Mic Night from 5:00 to 7:30 PM, welcoming musicians, poets, and other performers of any age. No pre-registration is required.

Other Programming

Bosler also runs "Music @ Bosler," a monthly concert series on the fourth Friday of each month from 7:00 to 8:00 PM featuring booked touring and local musicians across bluegrass, blues, folk, hip-hop, and West African genres.

Good to Know

Bosler Public Library is located at 158 West High Street in downtown Carlisle. Check the library's calendar for the current open mic date, as it does not run every week.

title: Open Mic @ The Dog House
event_description: A Thursday night open mic hosted by Erica Everest at a Linglestown BBQ and sports bar combo, part of the venue's planned lineup of live music and sports viewing.
event_venue_information:
The Dog House

The Dog House combines Shakedown BBQ with a sports-bar concept in Harrisburg's Linglestown area, serving barbecue, burgers, and sandwiches alongside TVs for sports viewing.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Dog House has a casual, family- and community-friendly neighborhood feel, blending its restaurant and sports-bar identities.

Open Mic

The Dog House hosts a Thursday night open mic led by Erica Everest, open to singer-songwriters and solo performers.

Other Programming

The venue also books live duo and band performances on other nights alongside its regular sports-bar programming.

Good to Know

The Dog House is located at 6791 Linglestown Road in Harrisburg.

title: Open Mic and Jam Night @ Pappy T's
event_description: A well-established Thursday open mic and jam at a pub and lounge in Hamburg, with a full house backline of PA, drums, and amps ready for players to use.
backline: PA system, drums, bass amp, and guitar amps provided
event_venue_information:
Pappy T's

Pappy T's Pub & Lounge is a pub across from Cabela's in Hamburg known for homemade food and a full weekly entertainment schedule.

Atmosphere and Setting

Pappy T's has the feel of a busy neighborhood pub built around its entertainment calendar, with a night for nearly every genre of fun throughout the week.

Open Mic and Jam Night

Every Thursday at 8:00 PM, Pappy T's hosts an open mic and jam night with a full house backline — a PA system, drums, bass amp, and guitar amps — ready for players to plug in and go.

Other Programming

Pappy T's also runs live bands every Saturday night, a DJ on Fridays, karaoke on Wednesdays, and free Texas Hold 'Em poker on Tuesdays.

Good to Know

Pappy T's is located at 50 Industrial Drive in Hamburg, across from Cabela's.

title: Open Mic @ Timeless Cafe
event_description: A free monthly open mic hosted by Matt Miskie at a welcoming Lebanon cafe known for its warm community of creative folks.
event_venue_information:
Timeless Cafe

Timeless Cafe, also known as BOHO Timeless Cafe, is a cafe in Lebanon known for breakfast, lunch, and catering, and described as a warm and welcoming community of creative folks.

Atmosphere and Setting

The cafe has a relaxed, artsy coffeehouse feel rather than a bar atmosphere, drawing musicians and other creatives to its monthly open mic.

Open Mic

On a Thursday each month, Timeless Cafe hosts a free open mic led by Matt Miskie. Sign-up begins at 5:00 PM, the host takes over at 5:45 PM, and performances start at 6:00 PM, with each performer given a 15-minute slot including setup. The night is BYOB and 21 and up, with outside food not permitted.

Other Programming

Outside of its monthly open mic, Timeless Cafe operates as Lebanon's daytime cafe and catering spot.

Good to Know

Timeless Cafe is located at 18 South 8th Street in Lebanon.

title: Open Mic @ Gus Deraco's
event_description: A free, all-ages monthly open mic hosted by John Holmes at an Italian sandwich shop in Lebanon, welcoming musicians, dancers, and spoken word performers.
event_venue_information:
Gus Deraco's

Gus Deraco's Italian Sandwiches is a family-run sandwich shop and restaurant in Lebanon, owned by Traci and Ron Ginnona, serving sandwiches, soups, salads, and ice cream.

Atmosphere and Setting

As a restaurant rather than a bar, Gus Deraco's offers a family-friendly, sober-friendly, all-ages alternative to a typical bar open mic.

Open Mic

On the last Thursday of the month starting at 6:00 PM, Gus Deraco's hosts a free open mic emceed by singer-songwriter John Holmes, welcoming musicians, dancers, actors, and spoken word artists of all ages and abilities. Informal jam sessions often continue past the scheduled end time.

Other Programming

Outside of its monthly open mic, Gus Deraco's operates as Lebanon's Italian sandwich shop and full-service restaurant.

Good to Know

Gus Deraco's is located at 714 Cumberland Street in Lebanon.

title: Poetry and Open Mic Night @ Consciousness Coffee
event_description: A free weekly Friday night open mic for poetry and music at an independent coffee and tea shop in Lemoyne, known as a cozy neighborhood gathering hub.
event_venue_information:
Consciousness Coffee

Consciousness Coffee is an independent specialty coffee and tea shop at Lemoyne Square, opened in 2024 and known locally as a cozy community gathering hub.

Atmosphere and Setting

The shop has a warm, welcoming coffeehouse feel, with complimentary parking and a small storefront setting that suits an intimate performance night.

Poetry and Open Mic Night

Every Friday at 6:00 PM, Consciousness Coffee hosts a free Poetry and Open Mic Night, welcoming spoken word and music performers to sign up and share their work.

Other Programming

Outside of its weekly open mic, Consciousness Coffee operates as Lemoyne's neighborhood coffee and tea shop.

Good to Know

Consciousness Coffee is located at 1 Lemoyne Square, Suite 108, in Lemoyne.

title: Open Mic Night @ The Cone
event_description: A family-friendly seasonal open mic on the patio of an iconic ice cream stand in Wernersville, mixing music and other performances during the warmer months.
event_venue_information:
The Cone

The Cone, also known as the Wertz Ice Cream Cone, is a classic roadside ice cream stand in Wernersville, recognizable by its giant cone-shaped building.

Atmosphere and Setting

The Cone has a bright, family-friendly, casual outdoor feel typical of a small-town ice cream stand, with seating around the stand for events.

Open Mic Night

During the warmer months, The Cone hosts a seasonal open mic night from 6:30 to 8:30 PM, welcoming musicians and other performers to sign up on-site. Spots tend to fill up quickly.

Other Programming

Outside of its open mic nights, The Cone operates as Wernersville's seasonal ice cream stand.

Good to Know

The Cone is located at 55 West Penn Avenue in Wernersville. The open mic runs seasonally rather than year-round, so check current listings before visiting.
